messages:
elena: quick ask — need a scribe + debrief lead for candidate tomorrow 11:00 PT. can anyone cover the 11:30 follow-up slot? :wave:

samir: @elena I can take scribe for 11:00. I'll be on rotation. do you want the standard debrief form or a condensed version?

elena: thanks @samir — condensed is fine. main ask: please capture strengths / risks + 3pt rubric scores. also capture a single-sentence recommendation.

maya: I can cover the 11:30 follow-up if needed. quick rubric q: for system design, do we weight infra experience higher (x1.2) or keep equal across categories?

devon: we keep equal for now, but please annotate 'infra exposure' in the notes field. people-ops prefers not to apply multiplicative weights unless the panel explicitly agrees.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: please use the debrief form — https://redwood.company/debriefs. Fill within 2h of interview. :memo:

samir: ok filing template i'll use:
```
Strengths:
Risks:
Scores (0-4): Technical / System / Product sense
Recommendation: Yes / No / Maybe
Score justification (1-2 sentences):
```

elena: perfect. small ops ask: please leave a 10min buffer after each interview for quick note-taking and to avoid runover. can engineering leads update calendar invites?

devon: @elena updated the invites and added a 10min buffer to the booking. ping me if anyone gets a conflict.

maya: one more suggestion — when you mark a candidate a '3' (above bar), please add a short reason. that helps normalization across panels when we aggregate later.

elena: agree. i'll add a 'score justification' required field to the form. thank you all :heart:
